# T-3: Stop upgrade seeding

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Remove normal upgrade behavior that adds package built-in agent profiles/providers to config while preserving existing user entries and unrelated migrations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 upgrade does not add built-in profiles/providers just because `raw.agent` exists.
- R5 existing `agent.profiles` and `agent.providers` entries remain unchanged.
- Unrelated upgrade config migrations and skill/preset deployment behavior remain covered.

## Implementation Notes
Adjust `src/upgrade.js` comments and summary/logging so they no longer describe agent defaults seed as normal migration behavior.

## Test Strategy
Add or update upgrade tests for no agent-default expansion, preservation of existing entries, and unchanged non-agent migration behavior.
